title: Ordering of Rider Benefits Against the Medical Plan's Embedded Allowance
content:
Where a member holds an Optional Supplemental Benefit Rider and their medical plan carries its own embedded dental, vision and hearing allowance, the rider held states how the two are ordered against one service.

| Rider | Ordering carried |
|---|---|
| Ridgecrest Preventive Dental Rider | the rider pays first and the medical plan's embedded allowance pays only what the rider left |
| Ridgecrest Vision Plus Rider | the rider pays first and the medical plan's embedded allowance pays only what the rider left |
| Ridgecrest Hearing Advantage Rider | the rider pays first and the medical plan's embedded allowance pays only what the rider left |
| Ridgecrest Comprehensive Dental Rider | the rider pays first and the medical plan's embedded allowance pays only what the rider left |
| Ridgecrest Premier Dental Rider | the rider pays first and the medical plan's embedded allowance pays only what the rider left |
| Ridgecrest Dental Vision Hearing Bundle Rider | the rider pays first and the medical plan's embedded allowance pays only what the rider left |

## Note

The ordering is the same term on all six riders: the rider pays first, and the medical plan's embedded allowance pays only what the rider left. The two are ordered against one service, not added together on it.
